messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

You are invited to our summer knowledge session, 'AI and the Future of Legal Drafting', on Thursday 19 June at 12:30 in the 8th-floor forum (lunch provided). Please RSVP to me by 16 June for catering.

Best wishes,
Donna Bridges | Practice Assistant
